# Shadow Papers: Series One Legendary Blend
By blending ONE Rare Series One Character, ONE Uncommon Series One Character, ONE Common Series One Character and THREE Twilight Ticket you will receive a random Pre-Minted Series One Epic rarity NFT.

**The Legendary rarity is the first GOLD NFT of these characters!**

*Try to collect ALL 5 Characters!*
*Yumi the Siamese Cat*
*Remington the Paperanian Dog*
*Penelope the Mini Goldendoodle*
*Scarlet the Cardinal*
*Hammy the Squirell*

**Only 11 of each character available!**
